note: Fixed-sample simulation-based sensitivity analysis (C1_ANALYSIS_SPEC.md Section 9), run against the observed post-QC usable participant count (16) and the observed behavior-only outer-fold Delta_OOS standard deviation from results/c1_incremental_validity.json (0.04931500749872951). Estimates power to detect a range of true subject-level mean Delta_OOS effects under the same paired sign-flip inference procedure used for the primary confirmatory result. Per-replication p-values use the Monte Carlo sign-flip approximation (sampled_sign_flip_p_value, 2000 samples/replication) rather than exact enumeration: at n_simulations=2000 outer replications, exact enumeration per replication (2**16 = 65536 terms) is computationally infeasible and adds no precision that matters at this scale, since the outer power simulation is itself already a Monte Carlo estimate. The primary confirmatory result itself (results/c1_incremental_validity.json) continues to use the exact enumeration test (exact_sign_flip_test), which is only ever called once, not in a simulation loop.
